name: holonovel-spec
description: Build specification for TTRPG MCP game servers with convergence-loop quality enforcement and job-gated pre-build configuration.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run validate:sdd && npm run test:validators && npm run test:spec-tooling && npm run validate-readme && npm run check-script-discipline && npm run check-script-quality && npm run check-workflows && npm run check-traceability && npm run check-markers && npm run check-registers:strict && npm run check-fingerprint-sync && npm run check-tool-definitions-sync && npm run tool-definitions-lint && npm run tool-citation-check && npm run check:conformance && npm run action-conflicts -- --check
scripts.check:fast: npm run lint && ( npm run validate:fast & a=$!; npm run validate-readme & b=$!; npm run check-traceability & c=$!; npm run check-script-discipline & d=$!; npm run check-script-quality & p=$!; npm run test:validators & e=$!; npm run test:spec-tooling & k=$!; npm run check-fingerprint-sync & f=$!; npm run check:conformance & g=$!; npm run check-markers & h=$!; npm run check-registers & i=$!; npm run action-conflicts & j=$!; npm run check-workflows & l=$!; npm run check-tool-definitions-sync & m=$!; npm run tool-definitions-lint & n=$!; npm run tool-citation-check & o=$!; s=0; wait $a || s=1; wait $b || s=1; wait $c || s=1; wait $d || s=1; wait $p || s=1; wait $e || s=1; wait $k || s=1; wait $f || s=1; wait $g || s=1; wait $h || s=1; wait $i || s=1; wait $j || s=1; wait $l || s=1; wait $m || s=1; wait $n || s=1; wait $o || s=1; if [ $s -eq 0 ]; then echo "check:fast: PASS"; else echo "check:fast: FAIL"; fi; exit $s )
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run detect-dupes
